title: When did I feel that I am a strong girl?
description: In “When Did I Feel That I Am a Strong Girl?” by Roqia Qasemi, Second Place Winner of the HerVoice 2026 Writing Contest, the writer reflects on the moments that shaped her understanding of strength as an Afghan girl living through violence, loss, and educational restrictions. Through powerful personal memories and unwavering determination, the piece explores how courage is forged in the face of injustice and how the pursuit of education becomes an act of resistance. Roqia’s story stands as a moving tribute to the resilience of Afghan girls who continue to rise, dream, and fight for their future despite immense obstacles.
from: National Society of High School Scholars (NSHSS)
